name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Government-backed small savings scheme under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign to secure the financial future of girl children through high compounding interest rates and complete tax exemptions.
target_beneficiaries: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child from her birth up to the age of 10 years (maximum two accounts per family)
benefits: Highest small savings interest rate (8.2% p.a.), triple tax exemption under Section 80C (EEE status), partial withdrawal up to 50% for higher education after age 18, and full account maturity after 21 years from account opening.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, Government of India.
source_evidence.citation: GSR 914(E), Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme Rules 2019

source_evidence.statement: Central small savings scheme offered through all Post Offices and authorized commercial bank branches in India.
Account can be opened by the guardian in the name of a girl child from the date of her birth until she attains the age of ten years.
Guaranteed annual compounding interest (8.2%), EEE tax status, minimum annual deposit of Rs. 250 and maximum of Rs. 1.50 lakh.
Official rules and notifications published at financialservices.gov.in.
Over 3.5 crore accounts actively opened with highest uptake under national girl-child financial literacy initiatives.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Maximum 2 accounts per family; exceptions allowed for triplets or twin girls born in second delivery.

required_documents.title: Birth Certificate of Girl Child
required_documents.description: Official birth certificate of the girl child issued by municipal registrar or competent local authority.
required_documents.issuing_authority: Municipal Corporation / Registrar of Births and Deaths

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card of Parent/Guardian
required_documents.description: Identity and address proof of the opening parent or legal guardian.
